description: This file defines a React component for a modal dialog that allows users to view and modify channel settings in Mattermost, including tabs for info, access rules, configuration, and archive options.

methods.name: updateTab
methods.description: Sets the active tab in the modal, showing an error if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleHide
methods.description: Handles modal close request, warns if there are unsaved changes.

methods.name: handleHideConfirm
methods.description: Confirms modal hide, resets preview states.

methods.name: handleExited
methods.description: Resets state after modal fade-out completes.

methods.name: renderTabContent
methods.description: Renders content based on the current active tab.

methods.name: renderAccessRulesTab
methods.description: Renders the Access Rules tab content.

methods.name: renderModalBody
methods.description: Renders the modal's body with sidebar and content.
